Offscreen. Echoing, a voice from a dream.

In this dreamlike corner of the Mindscape, Lilith slowly approaches an ANCIENT DOORWAY, OVERGROWN with long-thorned brambles. Bright daylight shines through the gaps, but we cannot see the scene unfolding on the other side– an ancient, painful memory.
Lilith extends a hand tenderly through the brambles, reaching into the sunlit memory -
- and returns with the DAGGER in hand. Fiery, hairline FRACTURES spread rapidly through the blade.
CRACK! The blade splits into 3 parts.
Lilith regards the pieces of the dagger hovering before her. After a beat, DAGGER AND PIECES VANISH into smoke. Nothing but a memory. Lilith turns back to us.
